title: GDPR User email opt-in compliance
body:
• Retention period for data (strict period must be set & included in the notice).
• Privacy notice to include how to opt out of promotional.
• Inform people what is being done with their data (through the privacy policy)
• Children privacy in privacy notice
• Message for current users not required, new users need to be informed about new marketing.
• Minimum age to register without consent. The UK is 13 years old. (consider other countries)
• Auditory trail with privacys vs consents.
• Consider if school postcode is private information.
• Right to be forgotten (a manual process documented). Other processes documented too. Store them centrally.
• Finally, do some ICO website high level law reading. https://ico.org.uk/for-organisations/guide-to-pecr/electronic-and-telephone-marketing/electronic-mail-marketing/
author: Participant 1
